steps.en: Describe the access model once in a CONF file: request shape, rule shape, matcher
steps.zh: 在 CONF 文件里一次写好访问模型：请求格式、规则格式、匹配式

steps.en: List who may do what as policy rows, in a CSV file or a database via an adapter
steps.zh: 把谁能做什么写成策略行，放 CSV 文件或经适配器存数据库

steps.en: Add the library and create an enforcer from model and policy
steps.zh: 引入库，用模型和策略创建一个 enforcer

steps.en: Loads model and policy into memory and resolves role inheritance
steps.zh: 把模型和策略加载进内存，解析角色继承

steps.en: Call it right before each protected operation
steps.zh: 在每个受保护操作之前调用它

steps.en: Evaluates the matcher against the rules, applies allow/deny effect, returns true or false
steps.zh: 用匹配式比对规则，套用允许或拒绝的合并方式，返回真或假

value.en: Who-can-do-what becomes a model file plus policy rows you edit, not if-statements spread across handlers
value.zh: 谁能做什么变成一份模型文件加若干策略行，不再是散落在各个处理函数里的 if 判断

sources: https://github.com/apache/casbin#how-it-works (PERM model CONF: request_definition, policy_definition, policy_effect, matchers; policy p, alice, data1, read)
